text:
maya: heads up — preview build failed on linkcheck, looks like anchors don't match when headings include inline code + emoji. example heading: `Install `redwood-infer@v2` :rocket:` jumps to the wrong fragment.
simon: can you paste the linkcheck output?

maya: here — small excerpt from the CI log:

```
ERROR: broken fragment: /docs/cli#install-redwood-inferv2 -> page exists but fragment not found
Checked 128 links, 1 broken fragment
```

docs-bot: build #342 preview failed — linkcheck reported 1 broken fragment in /docs/cli. See artifacts: s3://redwood-docs/previews/342/linkcheck.log :eyes:

felix: probable cause: mkdocs (and the markdown extension we use) slugifies headings differently from the link generator in our linkcheck tool when headings include inline code or emoji. backticks get dropped vs turned into literal text. two ways to fix:
- normalize slugify in mkdocs.yml to match linkcheck
- add explicit HTML anchors for problematic headings

anna: i'm leaning toward build-side normalization so authors don't need to edit content. but small doc patches (replace inline code in headings or add explicit anchors) are OK short-term.

maya: also noticed a couple images with spaces and parentheses in filenames — those create redirected links in the HTML. i'll run a rename script to hyphenate filenames and update references in the repo.

simon: i'll open a tiny PR. plan:
1) add a slugify override in mkdocs.yml that strips emoji and normalizes code ticks
2) add one-off explicit anchor for the CLI page heading as a patch
3) run local linkcheck: `mkdocs build && python scripts/linkcheck.py`

felix: here's a minimal slugify override to try (put under `plugins: - search:` block):

```yaml
plugins:
  - search
  - slugify:
      function: 're.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "", text.lower())'
```

(simon: this isn't real YAML plugin config, just a gist of the normalization we want — implement using the mkdocs-simple-hooks plugin or a short python slugify fn)

simon: PR opened: #456 — changed slugify using mkdocs plugin, added explicit anchor on /docs/cli and a test in tests/linkcheck_tests.py. Local linkcheck shows 0 errors.

maya: reviewed and left one small comment about the regex edge-case. otherwise looks good. i'll approve after tweak. :+1:

felix: once merged i'll trigger the preview build and run full linkcheck. if green we can backport to the stable branch.

docs-bot: build #343 queued by felix (preview).

maya: thanks everyone. small followup: i'll open a separate PR to rename images with spaces and update image alt text where needed.

simon: merging after CI passes. ping @felix for deploy-run.

maya: merged, preview passed, scheduled for deploy window tonight. :shipit:

docs-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-03-21 22:00 UTC.
